prompt.project_info: Create a safe, photorealistic elevator mirror selfie of an approved adult woman.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long wavy platinum-blonde hair under a forest-green baseball cap, wearing a black fitted ribbed long-sleeve top, a white high-waisted pleated skirt with secure coverage, opaque black tights, and a dark jacket draped over one forearm.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body mirror view inside a wood-paneled apartment elevator, chest-level phone angle slightly downward, hips angled with weight on one leg, black crossbody bag and small silver jewelry visible. Keep the pose confident but non-sexualized.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft warm overhead elevator light with a golden glow, quiet candid between-floors atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic smartphone mirror photography, natural proportions, portrait orientation, 3:4 ratio, 35mm equivalent perspective, moderate depth of field.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with long wavy platinum-blonde hair, forest-green cap, black ribbed long-sleeve top, white pleated skirt with secure coverage, opaque black tights, jacket over one arm, and black crossbody bag takes a full-body elevator mirror selfie. Use wood paneling, brushed metal, warm overhead light, and a relaxed confident non-sexualized pose. No watermark or invented logos.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized pose, nudity, lingerie, fishnet stockings, exposed underwear, transparent clothing, voyeuristic framing, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, warped mirror, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
